settings.heading: Every piece starts with a person.
settings.body:
I started Cut & Curated Keepsakes because I believe the gifts that matter most are the ones made for you — not pulled off a shelf, but thought about, crafted, and created with a specific person in mind.

What started as a hobby — pouring resin at my kitchen table late at night — turned into something I couldn't stop doing. Every time I saw someone's face when they received a personalized piece, I knew this was more than a hobby. It was a calling.

I'm based in Edmond, Oklahoma, and I make every single item by hand. There's no assembly line here. Just me, my craft supplies, and a whole lot of love.

Thank you for supporting a small business. It genuinely means everything.
settings.imageAlt: The maker behind Cut & Curated Keepsakes

items.heading: Made with intention
items.text: Every piece I create is made thoughtfully, with the recipient in mind from start to finish.

items.heading: Worth the wait
items.text: Made-to-order means your piece is never sitting in a warehouse. It's made fresh, just for you.

items.heading: Community first
items.text: I'm proud to be a local Edmond business. When you shop with me, you're supporting a real person.
